If that window works, I ll lock the date and share the final shot list and call sheet.

Final details:
- Shoot date/time: Dec 14, crew call 08:00, wrap by 13:00. Location: Helix HQ, Conference Room B.
- On-camera participants: Priya Nair (VP Product), Dr. Miguel Ortega (Head of Data Science).
- On-camera runtime: 12 minute interview (split), plus 20 minutes B-roll.

  * The problem they wanted to solve with Redwood (15-20s)
  * The impact: one measurable stat (Helix suggested 38% reduction in inference cost over three months) and a short note on developer velocity or reliability
  * Advice for peers evaluating inference platforms (30s)

- Sanjay: please send the finalized one-line ROI stat exactly as you want it read on camera. If safe to say 38% reduction, confirm with data owner.
- Elena: please confirm crew arrival time and whether you need any parking passes or building access forms. Also confirm whether BrightFrame will handle on-site release signing for any extra people who show up.
- Marissa: can you please create a short branded lower-third for each participant (name + title + Helix Health) and share PNGs by Dec 12?
- Laura: any legal check on the signed release we received? Quick thumbs up requested.

I ve uploaded the final shot list and call sheet to Drive and attached the release we received. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF

If we re all aligned, I ll send a calendar invite to lock the slot. Thanks everyone for moving fast here, excited to tell Helix s story.
